Trend: Labane as a named grocery cheese
Description: Shoppers already type לאבנה / labane in Wolt Market. Named strained labane (cow and goat) is still under-indexed versus anonymous white cheese tubs — especially Florentine, Ben Yehuda and Rehovot students, with kosher-certified tubs for Talpiot and Ashdod.

Trend: Raw tahini pantry beyond hummus tubs
Description: טחינה / tahini / tehina is a high-volume search. Dark stores still over-index ready hummus versus jarred raw tahini for home mixing — a listing that works in Jaffa/Wolfson, Haifa and Levinsky-adjacent Florentine without copying Osem hummus.

פיתה / pita and חומוס are daily searches, not restaurant-only. Range named pita (not generic sliced bread) plus hummus kits and pickles for weeknights — Florentine vegan kits stay plant-based; Jerusalem Talpiot and Ashdod need kosher-certified pita.
פולי קפה is already in-app. Nahat, Nomena and Naima make a grocery bag listing versus Elite instant. Florentine, Ben Yehuda, Herzliya and Haifa will take it; Ashdod family warehouses keep it short.
טבעוני / vegan and oat milk search in Tel Aviv. Florentine, Ben Yehuda and Top Dan can range plant cheeses and oat drinks; do not push the same set as a kosher hero in Jerusalem Talpiot or Ashdod.
